situation: A café chain that posts on Instagram for local customers.
complication: Engagement has fallen and a new location opens next month.
key_question: What should the chain post to make the new location's opening land on Instagram?

titles.situation: Instagram engagement has fallen since spring.
titles.options: Two ways to promote the opening on Instagram.
titles.recommendation: Lead with staff and behind-the-scenes posts.
titles.roadmap: Build up to the opening, then keep the new style going.
titles.kpis: Two measures show the new posts work.
titles.risks: The main risk is posting before the opening is confirmed.

issue_tree.finding: Engagement fell well below its spring level.

hypotheses.text: Fewer people see the chain's posts since spring.

issue_tree.so_what: The opening needs posts people respond to.

chart.title: Engagement now against spring and staff posts.

issue_tree.finding: Staff and behind-the-scenes posts engage far better.
points: At that rate a post earns about [F7] engagements, against [F6].

hypotheses.text: Faces and real moments drive the higher engagement.

issue_tree.so_what: The opening campaign should feature the new team.

options.name: Staff-led opening posts
options.description: Introduce the new team and show the fit-out in the run-up to the opening.

options.name: Offer-led posts
options.description: Lead with an opening discount in every post.

recommendation.rationale: Staff posts engage at [F3] against [F2] overall; the marketing lead approves each post before it goes up.

actions: Send the opening posts to the marketing lead for approval.
Photograph the new team and the fit-out.
Post the approved run-up and opening-day posts before and on the opening next month.
Keep posting staff and behind-the-scenes content after the opening.
Compare engagement on staff posts with other posts.

risks.mitigation: Name the date only once the marketing lead confirms it.

risks.risk: Staff do not want to appear.
risks.mitigation: Ask each person first and use hands and coffee shots instead.

work.title: Opening week posts for the new café
work.for: Instagram followers, posts for the marketing lead to approve before posting
body: Post one, photo of the new team behind the counter: Meet the crew behind our newest café. They can't wait to make your first coffee here. Say hi when you visit.
Post two, behind-the-scenes video of the fit-out: Our new café is nearly ready, and we wanted you to see it first.
Post three, close-up of the head barista: Meet the head barista at our new spot. Come in and ask for their favourite on the menu.
Post four, opening day: Doors open today at {address to confirm}. Come in, grab a coffee and meet the team. Tag a friend you'd bring along.
